guide.heading: Venus helps make the financial conversation easier to understand.
paragraphs: Venus is a Pru Life UK Unit Manager, mom, wife, and founder of Intentional Thrive. She created this space for professionals who want honest financial literacy, not overwhelming jargon.
This site is her public authority hub: client education, career mentorship, practical resources, and a more human way to talk about money.
